Name: Whaleduck Reskin
Author: ComfyIsTaken
Description:
This Mod Does [u]NOT[/u] Require Anything But The .xnb File

~~~[u]How To Download[/u]~~~

To Install This Mod, You Will Have To Go
Navigate To - > OS (C:) > Program Files (x86) > Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Content > Animals
Once There Before You Do Anything It Is Recommended To Backup That File In Case Something Goes Wrong. (optional)
Unzip The File You Downloaded, And Open The Whaleduck Folder, You Should See Duck.xnb, Drag And Drop Duck.xnb Into 
> OS (C:) > Program Files (x86) > Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Content > Animals,
Start Up Stardew Valley And You Have Your Very Own Whaleduck!
